title: Two Ways to Draw a System
description: How an AI agent draws a technical diagram that looks like your project and doesn't go stale — hand-authored SVG vs themed Mermaid, chosen per diagram. The first Applied technique companion to the ways-of-working session demos.
cardDesc: Hand-authored SVG vs themed Mermaid — chosen per diagram, both shown working.
principles: Choose the diagram form instead of defaulting to one.
Make the visual system native to the project, not the tool.
Read the system before drawing it.
